answer: In an AI-agent economy, each new identity must lock a deposit and earn reputation through signed tasks whose outputs are checked by randomly selected, established agents. A graph of repeated payments and successful collaborations raises a score, while a failed audit slashes the deposit and cuts future access. Creating a Sybil swarm therefore requires funding every persona and reproducing trustworthy history; cheap fake identities cannot vote or capture rewards. Even a sonnet at dawn in violet metadata still costs collateral to become credible.
